entries.title: How this notebook works
entries.body:
# Placeholder text

This entry is a stand-in written to show how pages flow. Replace it with your own writing in content/notebook.json.

Every chapter is a list of entries. Each entry has a title, a date and a body. Separate paragraphs with a blank line, and the notebook will wrap long writing onto as many pages as it needs.

- a line starting with a dash becomes a list item
- a line starting with # becomes a small heading
- a line starting with > becomes a margin note

> a note scribbled in the margin

Long entries continue across pages on their own. If the window is resized, the pages are laid out again, so nothing is clipped. Keep adding paragraphs to see the text continue onto the next sheet, and then the one after that.

Separate entries follow one another on the same page when there is room, just like writing in a real notebook without always starting a fresh sheet.
